purpose: Teach: よせ/想う/絶好調/道端/窮屈/ハメ/等しく/踏み出し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人をからかうのはよせって、メイ姉さんからの言葉ね
lines.en: Sho, stop teasing people — that's big sister Mei telling you.
lines.style: Warm but pointed. Gentle reproach with a smile underneath. Takes his hand like she's not angry, just reminding. Soft rhythm, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんを想う気持ちでお絵描きしたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I drew a picture thinking about Grandpa.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Speaking carefully, like he's offering something precious. Small but steady. Watching her face to see if she understands.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きのアイデアが絶好調ね
lines.en: Sho, your art ideas are really flowing today, aren't they?
lines.style: Genuine delight. Open vowels. Leans in to look at his work. Not performing praise — actually seeing him. Warm, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、道端でメイ姉さんに似た花見つけたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I found a flower by the road that looks just like you.
lines.style: Excited but gentle. Like he's sharing a secret discovery. Quick breath before 'looks like you' — shy about the compliment. Eager to show her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの服、ちょっと窮屈そうね
lines.en: Sho, my clothes are feeling a bit snug today.
lines.style: Slightly embarrassed admission. Touches her sleeve absently. Not complaining — just noticing out loud. Soft, self-aware.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの絵を真似するハメになっちゃった
lines.en: Mei-san, I ended up trying to copy your drawing style.
lines.style: Dry, almost amused at himself. Like he got caught doing something silly. Self-deprecating but not sorry about it. Light, wry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描き道具は仲良く等しく分けましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's share the art supplies fairly between us, okay?
lines.style: Practical kindness. Clear and matter-of-fact. Treating him like someone who understands fairness. Gentle direction, not an order.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、新しい絵の世界に一歩踏み出したよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I took my first step into a whole new world of drawing.
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. Like he's discovered something bigger than himself. Slight breath of amazement. Tender, growing confidence.
